newsitem.title: USA: Enron says US Gulf gas line back today.
newsitem.headline: Enron says US Gulf gas line back today.

text.p: Enron Corp said Thursday that unplanned maintenance on a U.S. Gulf natural gas line, which was shut January 27, was completed and 200 million cubic feet per day of curtailed gas flow had been restored.
"The MOPS (Matagorda Offshore Pipeline System) line came back in service today. We were accepting interday noms (nominations) today," a company spokeswoman said.
On Wednesday, the company said the in service date had been extended to Friday, February 7.
The line, which flows an average 400 mmcfd and is operated by Enron's Houston Pipe Line unit, runs from Mustang Island Block 831 offshore Texas to Tivoli, Texas.
The curtailment affected flows south of platform 686.
